# פיכפידע — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> Pikpida is a fun and educational Hebrew-language platform where children and young learners come to master 'pikpuk' (a playful form of speech or wordplay) and gain general knowledge. The brand has a youthful, energetic, and trustworthy personality, aiming to attract parents and kids with a reliable and inviting online presence. The platform includes a registration form collecting basic personal and parental details, emphasizing safety and credibility.

### Contact form

- Method: POST
- Content-Type: application/json
- Fields:
  - `שם_פרטי` (text, required)
  - `שם_משפחה` (text, required)
  - `גיל` (number, required)
  - `מספר_טלפון` (tel, required)
  - `שם_הורה` (text, required)
  - `privacy_consent` (checkbox, required)

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About פיכפידע
Pikpida is a fun and educational Hebrew-language platform where children and young learners come to master 'pikpuk' (a playful form of speech or wordplay) and gain general knowledge. The brand has a youthful, energetic, and trustworthy personality, aiming to attract parents and kids with a reliable and inviting online presence. The platform includes a registration form collecting basic personal and parental details, emphasizing safety and credibility.

## Target Audience
- ילדים ובני נוער המעוניינים ללמוד פכפוך וידע כללי
- אנשים אשר רוצים לפכפך

## Industry
Education
